symbols.read: The bullish FVG at 719.67–728.71 has been consumed and removed from the open list, so the prior support shelf beneath price no longer exists as a structural backstop. Price is holding at 731.80, still above the 722.40 lower pivot, but the last 1H candle closed red (-0.15%) and the 4H remains bearish, keeping the combined stance at HOLD rather than a confirmed long. The overhead 734.5–735.01 supply and the 737.02 invalidation level are now the decisive test: a sustained reclaim of 737.02 flips the regime bullish toward 758.44, while a break under 722.40 revives the short toward 686.36. Bias stays neutral-to-constructive only while 722.40 holds; losing it turns the read bearish.

Price has pushed marginally higher to 82,385.86 but the 1H trend flip to down (82,409.99→82,384.73) is the first crack in the up-move, and the bear FVG at 83,102.73–83,338.00 remains untested overhead supply. The bias stays neutral-to-constructive above 81,033.66, but the failed push toward 83,338.00 and the stalling 1H momentum argue against chasing longs here. The bull FVG at 80,772.98–81,755.01 is the support shelf; a loss of 81,033.66 revives the short toward 77,715.32, while a clean break of 83,338.00 opens 84,352.00. Compared to the prior read, the constructive stance is unchanged but the 1H up-trend has weakened, so the setup is now a range-hold rather than a continuation.

Price at 2,460.63 has pushed into the first bear FVG (2,457.22–2,474.79) flagged in the prior read, but the 1H upswing has stalled — the last candle is a flat +0.05% versus the +1.85% impulse that drove the reclaim, so momentum is fading right at supply. The 4H remains bearish and the combined read stays HOLD, unchanged from before; the 2,403.69 pivot now holds as the lower support, with the old bull FVG at 2,399.44–2,423.16 sitting just beneath it as the demand shelf to defend. Bias is neutral-to-cautious-short into this FVG: rejection here keeps the bearish 4H case alive, while a sustained break above 2,579.88 flips the regime BULLISH and kills the short thesis outright. Invalidation for the short lean is a clean hold above 2,474.79, which opens the second FVG at 2,487.49–2,500.41.

The SELL is now invalidated: price never triggered the 107.16 entry and has instead settled at 106.05, with the 4H bearish direction reduced to a HOLD against a 1H uptrend and a BULLISH regime. The prior read's trigger — rejection at the 106.49–106.66 FVG — never resolved into a breakdown, and that FVG is no longer listed; the only open gap is now bullish at 105.05–105.13, which price is holding above. Bias flips to neutral-to-bullish: holding 105.05 keeps the path toward 107.16, and a break of that level reopens 113.40. Invalidation for the bullish lean is a loss of the 105.05–105.13 bull FVG, which would put 100.92 back in play.

The bearish setup has weakened materially: the combined 4H+1H signal flipped from SELL to HOLD, the 1H trend turned up, and the last 1H candle closed +0.66% at 57.50 — a push back above the 57.473–58.374 bearish FVG that previously capped price. The prior short-on-rejection structure is now marked EXPIRED, with the 58.41 entry never triggered and price instead basing above a fresh bull FVG at 57.0865–57.1075. Bias shifts to neutral-to-mildly-bullish while price holds above that FVG, with 58.41 the first level to reclaim for continuation toward the 61.45 upper pivot. The bearish read is only revived on a clean loss of 57.0865, which would reopen the 55.37 target; a sustained break above 58.41 confirms the prior short thesis is dead.

Price has pushed further to 4,175.69, extending the hold above the 4,141.44 lower pivot and confirming the prior read's neutral-to-cautious stance — the 1H trend remains up and the bearish 4H case is still not reversed. The setup has strengthened slightly: two new bull FVGs (4,153.075–4,153.125 and 4,154.88–4,157.91) have formed beneath price, adding stacked support shelves alongside the original 4,090.79–4,092.755 gap, so no overhead bearish gap caps upside and the path toward the 4,217.40 upper pivot stays open. The SELL setup remains invalidated, and with 4H direction still bearish against a rising 1H, the combined read stays HOLD rather than a fresh long. Invalidation: a sustained break back below 4,141.44 re-arms the bearish 4H case toward the 4,065.48 target; a clean hold keeps the upside bias intact.

Bias stays neutral-to-long: price is holding at 1.34 with the 1H trend up, and the 4H bearish direction is the only counterweight, keeping the combined read at HOLD rather than a clean long. The prior overhead test at 1.353–1.3567 has not been cleared — the last 1H printed just +0.09% (1.34→1.34), so momentum has stalled right below it, and the two open bull FVGs at 1.3045–1.3218 and 1.3266–1.3291 now sit beneath price as the support shelf replacing the old 1.31 line. The invalidated SELL from 1.31 remains dead, and nothing here re-arms it while 1.31 holds. Invalidation: a push through 1.353–1.3567 opens 1.3668–1.3704 and keeps the bullish regime intact toward the 1.43 pivot; losing 1.31 revives the 1.20 target and the short with 1.37 as stop.
